title: LLM-based Source Code Compression via Thresholded Symbol Ranking
venue: 24th International Conference of the Italian Association for Artificial Intelligence
abstract: We introduce LLM-based compressors with novel symbol-ranking variants bounding predictions to the top-T ranks. Our approach outperforms prior LLM-based compressors in compression ratio (up to 37%) and throughput (40% faster) across 30 LLMs, including code-specialized and quantized models.

title: MIEO: encoding clinical data to enhance cardiovascular event prediction
authors: Davide Borghini, Davide Marchi, Angelo Nardone, Giordano Scerra, Silvia Giulia Galfrè, Alessandro Pingitore, Giuseppe Prencipe, Corrado Priami, Alina Sîrbu
venue: International Conference on Computational Intelligence Methods for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics
abstract: A self-supervised autoencoder approach for embedding heterogeneous clinical data into a latent space, enabling improved cardiovascular event prediction — particularly in low-label settings — compared to models trained on raw clinical data.
